sourceEvidence.title: Director of Production
sourceEvidence.quote: Required 10-15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, or related environments. 5+ years leading manufacturing or production teams. Experience owning production operations involving assembly, materials, supply chain, logistics, inventory, and/or kitting. No degree requirement or preference is stated in the posting. Base pay range $265,000.00/yr - $290,000.00/yr provided by employer.

requirements.quote: 10-15+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, operations, supply chain, or related environments.
Identify and eliminate manufacturing bottlenecks using Lean manufacturing, root-cause analysis, standard work, and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to transition new products from development into repeatable production.
Experience supporting NPI through production ramp and rate manufacturing.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization across production, assembly, materials, kitting, warehouse, supply chain, and logistics.
